'''Card Captor''', also known as "'''The Captain'''," was the codename for the [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Sullustan/Legends|Sullustan]] who ran the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] cell on [[Cloud City/Legends|Cloud City]] since a year before the [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|Battle of Hoth]].<ref name="Cloud Cover!" />

Shortly before the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]], he provided the nav-coordinates to the Rebel [[Safe world/Legends|safe world]] [[Kaliska]] to agents tasked with rescuing several relatives of Alliance personnel.<ref name="Cloud Cover!" />
